---
title: "Network — 도메인과 repo의 그래프"
subtitle: "도메인 그래프 (클릭하면 repo로 드릴다운) + Org→Topic Sankey"
---

노드는 학문 도메인, edge는 두 도메인의 토픽 분포 유사도(코사인)입니다. 도메인을 클릭하면 그 안의 repo 그래프로 내려갑니다.

repo 134개를 한 화면에 놓으면 거의 모든 쌍이 토픽을 공유해 그래프가 hairball이 되므로, 상위 계층을 도메인으로 두고 드릴다운합니다.

## 도메인 그래프

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div id="cy" style="height: 620px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--aa-snu-ice);"></div>
  <p id="cy-status" style="margin-top:8px; font-size:0.9rem; color: var(--aa-snu-gray);"></p>
</div>
```

## Org → Topic Sankey

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div id="sankey"></div>
</div>

<script type="module">
import * as d3 from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/+esm";
import { sankey as d3sankey, sankeyLinkHorizontal, sankeyJustify } from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-sankey@0.12.3/+esm";
import cytoscape from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cytoscape@3.30.0/+esm";

// Rendered twice from the same source: the public profile reads the redacted
// data/pub, the lab profile (QUARTO_PROFILE=lab) reads data/lab.
const ROOT = window.AA_DATA_ROOT ?? "data/pub";

const [commits, embeddings, topicsDoc, palette] = await Promise.all([
  fetch(`${ROOT}/commits_slim.json`).then(r => r.json()),
  fetch(`${ROOT}/embeddings.json`).then(r => r.json()),
  fetch(`${ROOT}/topics.json`).then(r => r.json()),
  fetch(`${ROOT}/palette.json`).then(r => r.json()),
]);

const topics = topicsDoc.topics;
const shaToTopic = new Map(embeddings.map(e => [e.sha, e.topic_id]));
const topicById = new Map(topics.map(t => [t.topic_id, t]));
const orgColors = {
  "snuconnectome": "#003380",
  "Transconnectome": "#0072B2",
  "neurox-org": "#E69F00",
};

// ─── Build the graph ──────────────────────────────────────
// Nodes are scientific domains, not repos. With 134 repos and 12 topics almost
// every pair shared a topic, so the repo graph was a near-complete hairball:
// ~9,000 candidate edges and labels overlapping into illegible mush. Domains
// give a readable top level; picking one expands its repos underneath.
//
// Edges are cosine similarity over topic-distribution vectors, keeping each
// node's strongest few links, rather than "shares ≥1 topic" — at this scale the
// latter is true of nearly everything and therefore says nothing.
const TOP_K = 3;

function groupBy(rows, keyFn) {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const r of rows) {
    const k = keyFn(r);
    if (!m.has(k)) m.set(k, []);
    m.get(k).push(r);
  }
  return m;
}

function topicVector(rows) {
  const v = new Map();
  for (const c of rows) {
    const t = shaToTopic.get(c.sha) ?? -1;
    if (t === -1) continue;
    v.set(t, (v.get(t) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return v;
}

function cosine(a, b) {
  let dot = 0, na = 0, nb = 0;
  for (const [, x] of a) na += x * x;
  for (const [, y] of b) nb += y * y;
  for (const [t, x] of a) dot += x * (b.get(t) ?? 0);
  return na && nb ? dot / Math.sqrt(na * nb) : 0;
}

function buildElements(rows, keyFn, labelFn, colorFn) {
  const groups = groupBy(rows, keyFn);
  const keys = [...groups.keys()].sort();
  const vectors = new Map(keys.map(k => [k, topicVector(groups.get(k))]));
  const maxN = Math.max(...keys.map(k => groups.get(k).length), 1);

  const nodes = keys.map(k => {
    const n = groups.get(k).length;
    return { data: {
      id: k,
      label: labelFn(k),
      n,
      // Area, not radius, tracks commit count; capped so one dominant node
      // cannot swallow the canvas.
      size: 26 + 54 * Math.sqrt(n / maxN),
      color: colorFn(k),
    } };
  });

  const scored = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < keys.length; j++) {
      const w = cosine(vectors.get(keys[i]), vectors.get(keys[j]));
      if (w > 0.05) scored.push({ a: keys[i], b: keys[j], w });
    }
  }
  const keep = new Set();
  for (const k of keys) {
    scored.filter(e => e.a === k || e.b === k)
      .sort((x, y) => y.w - x.w)
      .slice(0, TOP_K)
      .forEach(e => keep.add(e));
  }
  const edges = [...keep].map(e => ({ data: {
    id: `${e.a}--${e.b}`, source: e.a, target: e.b, weight: e.w,
  } }));

  return { nodes, edges };
}

const domainOf = c => c.domain ?? "unclassified";
const domainElements = buildElements(
  commits, domainOf, k => k, k => palette.domain[k] ?? "#888");

const { nodes, edges } = domainElements;

// ─── Cytoscape ────────────────────────────────────────────
const cy = cytoscape({
  container: document.getElementById("cy"),
  elements: { nodes, edges },
  style: [
    {
      selector: "node",
      style: {
        "background-color": "data(color)",
        "label": "data(label)",
        "width": "data(size)",
        "height": "data(size)",
        "font-size": "11px",
        "color": "#282945",
        "text-valign": "bottom",
        "text-margin-y": 4,
        "border-width": 2,
        "border-color": "white",
      },
    },
    {
      selector: "edge",
      style: {
        // weight is a cosine similarity in (0,1], so the domain is fixed and
        // no longer a hardcoded guess at the maximum shared-topic count.
        "width": "mapData(weight, 0, 1, 1, 6)",
        "line-color": "#A0A0A0",
        "opacity": 0.45,
        "curve-style": "bezier",
      },
    },
    {
      selector: "node:active, node.hl",
      style: {
        "border-width": 4,
        "border-color": "#E69F00",
      },
    },
  ],
  layout: {
    name: "cose",
    idealEdgeLength: 140,
    nodeRepulsion: 12000,
    animate: true,
    animationDuration: 600,
    fit: true,
    padding: 40,
  },
});

// ─── Drill-down: domain → its repos ───────────────────────
const status = document.getElementById("cy-status");
let currentDomain = null;

function relayout() {
  cy.layout({
    name: "cose", idealEdgeLength: 140, nodeRepulsion: 12000,
    animate: true, animationDuration: 500, fit: true, padding: 40,
  }).run();
}

function showDomains() {
  currentDomain = null;
  cy.elements().remove();
  cy.add([...domainElements.nodes, ...domainElements.edges]);
  relayout();
  status.textContent = `도메인 ${domainElements.nodes.length}개 · 노드를 클릭하면 그 안의 repo가 펼쳐집니다`;
}

function showRepos(domain) {
  const rows = commits.filter(c => domainOf(c) === domain);
  const el = buildElements(
    rows, c => `${c.org}/${c.repo}`, k => k.split("/")[1],
    () => palette.domain[domain] ?? "#888");
  currentDomain = domain;
  cy.elements().remove();
  cy.add([...el.nodes, ...el.edges]);
  relayout();
  status.innerHTML =
    `<strong>${domain}</strong> — repo ${el.nodes.length}개, commit ${rows.length}건 · ` +
    `<a href="#" id="cy-back">← 도메인 전체로</a>`;
  document.getElementById("cy-back").addEventListener("click", ev => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    showDomains();
  });
}

cy.on("tap", "node", ev => {
  if (currentDomain === null) showRepos(ev.target.id());
});

showDomains();

// ─── Sankey: Org → Topic (d3-sankey, manual SVG) ──────────
const orgTopicCount = new Map();
for (const c of commits) {
  const t = shaToTopic.get(c.sha) ?? -1;
  if (t === -1) continue;
  const k = `${c.org}|${t}`;
  orgTopicCount.set(k, (orgTopicCount.get(k) ?? 0) + 1);
}

const orgSet = [...new Set(commits.map(c => c.org))];
const topicSet = topics.filter(t => t.topic_id !== -1);
const nodeList = [
  ...orgSet.map(o => ({ name: o, kind: "org", color: orgColors[o] ?? "#888" })),
  ...topicSet.map(t => ({ name: t.label, kind: "topic", color: t.color, topic_id: t.topic_id })),
];
// Key topics by topic_id, not by label: KMeans fallback labels are TF-IDF
// top-words, so two clusters can produce the same string and silently
// overwrite each other's index — dropping their Sankey links without error.
const nameIndex = new Map(
  nodeList.map((n, i) => [n.kind === "topic" ? `topic:${n.topic_id}` : `org:${n.name}`, i]),
);

const linkList = [];
for (const [k, v] of orgTopicCount) {
  const [org, topicStr] = k.split("|");
  const topic_id = +topicStr;
  const topic = topicById.get(topic_id);
  if (!topic || topic.topic_id === -1) continue;
  const srcIdx = nameIndex.get(`org:${org}`);
  const tgtIdx = nameIndex.get(`topic:${topic.topic_id}`);
  if (srcIdx === undefined || tgtIdx === undefined) continue;
  linkList.push({ source: srcIdx, target: tgtIdx, value: v, color: topic.color });
}

const sankeyWidth = 980;
const sankeyHeight = 400;
const sankeyLayout = d3sankey()
  .nodeId(d => d.index)
  .nodeAlign(sankeyJustify)
  .nodeWidth(16)
  .nodePadding(14)
  .extent([[16, 20], [sankeyWidth - 200, sankeyHeight - 10]]);

const { nodes: laidNodes, links: laidLinks } = sankeyLayout({
  nodes: nodeList.map(n => ({ ...n })),
  links: linkList.map(l => ({ ...l })),
});

const sankeyDiv = document.getElementById("sankey");
sankeyDiv.innerHTML = "";
const svg = d3.select(sankeyDiv).append("svg")
  .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${sankeyWidth} ${sankeyHeight}`)
  .attr("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet")
  .attr("style", "width:100%; max-width:980px; background:transparent; font-family: var(--aa-font-en);");

// Links
svg.append("g")
  .attr("fill", "none")
  .selectAll("path")
  .data(laidLinks)
  .join("path")
  .attr("d", sankeyLinkHorizontal())
  .attr("stroke", d => d.color)
  .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.42)
  .attr("stroke-width", d => Math.max(1, d.width))
  .append("title")
  .text(d => `${d.source.name} → ${d.target.name}\n${d.value} commit${d.value === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);

// Nodes
const nodeG = svg.append("g")
  .selectAll("g")
  .data(laidNodes)
  .join("g");

nodeG.append("rect")
  .attr("x", d => d.x0)
  .attr("y", d => d.y0)
  .attr("height", d => Math.max(1, d.y1 - d.y0))
  .attr("width", d => d.x1 - d.x0)
  .attr("fill", d => d.color)
  .attr("rx", 2)
  .append("title")
  .text(d => `${d.name}\n${d.value} commit${d.value === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);

nodeG.append("text")
  .attr("x", d => d.x0 < sankeyWidth / 2 ? d.x1 + 6 : d.x0 - 6)
  .attr("y", d => (d.y1 + d.y0) / 2)
  .attr("dy", "0.35em")
  .attr("text-anchor", d => d.x0 < sankeyWidth / 2 ? "start" : "end")
  .attr("font-size", 12)
  .attr("fill", "var(--aa-snu-dark)")
  .text(d => `${d.name} · ${d.value}`);
</script>
```
